locks.text: Only cryptoxdog/IB-Odoo_19 may change in the future. EIE, CEG, Constellation.Gate service and SDK contracts are read-only.
Retain and complete plasticos_enrichment as a single Odoo-native human approval and writeback shell, not a new addon.
Keep automatic CRM writeback OFF. No EIE-returned CRM fields may be applied before granular authorized user approval.
Preserve current data and audit through start-clean: no destructive table wipes, dropped evidence, or fabricated historical review.
Retired local crawl/extract/inference engine and both old cron entrypoints remain disabled and uncallable.
Odoo is Gate consumer. Gate -> EIE is external intelligence authority; Odoo never bypasses Gate.
Approve or reject each proposed field. Run-level EIE confidence is not field-level confidence and missing citations are explicitly labeled.
Allowlist of eight `res.partner` fields is unchanged; all nonallowlisted fields are evidence-only and cannot write.
Native CRM existing nonempty/verified values win. Typed source snapshot freshness and approval must be rechecked under target row lock before write.
Only authorized Odoo enrichment roles may review/apply. Server-side ACL, company rules and method guards must agree. No broad base.group_user CRUD.
Do not create res.partner for partnerless prospects. Current enrichment run remains existing partner-only.
Proposal is an immutable projection of stored Gate evidence; provenance records actual applied writes, not arbitrary approvals.
Human action with no field-level EIE citation must not silently invent one. Allow user-attested evidence where current policy permits, clearly distinguished and attributable.
No double apply, stale-value overwrite, partial unlogged write, or retry-induced duplicate outcome.
Run/field state machines deny arbitrary RPC state+payload mutation; preserve historical run records.
Source/manifest/ADR changes must preserve source-owner meaning and current active INVARIANTS.md. Candidate POS draft is not constitutional.
No new CEG overnight scheduler, ranked queue consumer, offering/matching, semantic kernel, or automatic EIE callback to Odoo.
Use native Odoo model security, form/list/one2many, mail.thread and PostgreSQL row locking before adding new infrastructure.
Migrate additively from actual installed module versions; preserve source UUID/packet/audit, disabled cron state and original DB+filestore snapshots.
No implementation, PR, merge, live paid calls, migration, deploy or activation is authorized by this planning ZIP.
Every material direct and transitive source effect has owner, file, disposition, safe migration, recovery, positive and negative proof; new consumer reopens affected plan.
